companyDescription: eVTOL Air Taxi · First manufacturer to complete FAA Type Certification Phase 3 of 4 · Acquiring Boeing's Wisk Aero, Insitu & SkyGrid (antitrust cleared Sep 2026) · $1.56B cash cushion
priceNote: Live $4.205 (+1.82%) on Nov 4, 2026 — up ~10% from $3.81 at the Oct 26 report (52-week $3.68-$9.85); 52-week range $3.68-$9.85. Nov 4 tape: S&P futures -1.2% / Nasdaq -2% on a Democratic midterm sweep; Dec 9 hike ~85% priced.
summary: REFRESH (prior report Oct 26, 2026): Q3 results on Nov 9 are the next dated event; FAA Type Certification Phase 4 (final) remains H2 2026-targeted and the Boeing Wisk/Insitu/SkyGrid acquisition close is guided for December. Pre-revenue (~$6.9M TTM revenue vs ~$800M TTM loss) with a ~$1.56B cash cushion — survival is fine; the thesis is certification timing. regulatory_approval is a Tier-2 LEADER (+5.3pp vs +2.0pp, n=8). Base cut from +45% to +45% (above the lane's realized 30d P75 (+12.2%; written-Base bias +72.7pp)), assuming Q3 reaffirming the certification timeline plus the December deal close over ~1-3 months. แนะนำ 1.5% ของ portfolio เท่านั้น — ถ้า thesis fail ลงได้ 40-50%.

risks: Pre-revenue: TTM revenue ~$6.9M against a ~$800M TTM net loss. The thesis is entirely certification and commercialization timing.
Rate-sensitive, high-beta stock: it has repeatedly sold off on rising Treasury yields, even with ample cash.
No confirmed FAA Phase 4 timeline yet; 2026 commercial-launch targets could slip into 2027.
The Wisk/Insitu/SkyGrid acquisition still needs remaining regulatory approvals, and integrating three Boeing subsidiaries is complex.
A single eVTOL safety incident, Archer's or a competitor's, would hit the whole sector.

macroRisk.rateOutlook: Fed held at 3.75–4.00% on Oct 28 (10–2 vote; Cook and Hammack dissented for a hike). Futures price ~85% odds of another +25bp at the Dec 9 FOMC after Logan and Musalem called for more tightening; Warsh gave no explicit December signal.
macroRisk.inflationNote: Sep PCE: headline 3.6% y/y (+0.5% m/m), core 3.1% y/y (+0.3% m/m); Q3 GDP +3.4% annualized. Oct CPI on Nov 10 is the next test — core ≥0.4% m/m would effectively lock in the December hike.
macroRisk.sectorImpact: Well-funded but pre-revenue and high-beta. ACHR has repeatedly traded on Treasury yields, so a hawkish surprise hits the multiple even though solvency isn't in question.
macroRisk.summary: MEDIUM — a long-duration pre-revenue name; a December hike weighs on the multiple, the cash pile limits survival risk.

entryStrategy.verdict: SPECULATIVE · ค่าขนม 1.5% max (refreshed Nov 4) — well-funded, but the moonshot is certification timing that has slipped before. Measured turbo at-catalyst median is -13.7% (n=19), so Entry 2 ($3.7-3.95) is preferred.

catalystSpot.preRunup: No run-up: ACHR fell ~26% since Sep 29 to a new 52-week low, even as ARK bought ~2.57M shares (~$12.1M) in early October.

postWin.note: Full FAA Type Certification (Phase 4) remains the single biggest catalyst in company history — no eVTOL company has completed this yet, so Archer as first mover is the reference case. This is unchanged from the last report; per turbo.tier2, regulatory_approval is a LEADER type (medianExcessVsBenchPct +5.3pp vs overall +2.0pp, n=8), supporting this sizing.
postWin.exampleDate: No direct historical comp — first mover

postLose.note: A major Phase 4 delay, a sector-wide safety incident, or the Boeing deal collapsing on remaining regulatory approvals would likely trigger a sharp de-rate. The recent -7% single-day move on rising yields alone shows how quickly sentiment can turn even without company-specific bad news.

spotSizing.reason: 1.5%. regulatory_approval is a Tier-2 LEADER (+5.3pp vs +2.0pp, n=8); the lane-wide prior (hitRate 4.9%) and a ~$3.2B cap keep it at 1.5%.

stopPreCatalyst.note: Wider than the turbo regulatory_approval medianMAE (n=8) (-25%). A break below the tight stop before the catalyst means a certification slip is being priced.

stopPostCatalyst.note: If Q3 pushes certification or commercial launch into late 2027, or announces a large discounted raise, exit.

comparableCases.note: Same-day +4.02% reaction to becoming the first eVTOL manufacturer to complete Phase 3 — direct evidence of how the market reacts to certification-phase milestones; full Type Certification (Phase 4) should be a materially larger version of this same reaction.
